breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained conflicting instructions for the numerical method, specifying both 'time_integration: Explicit forward Euler' and a more complex 'method: Strang splitting'. The ground truth resolved this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction entirely. The agent failed to fix this inconsistency and instead repeated the erroneous instruction by stating the method is a 'Strang splitting scheme with explicit forward Euler time integration'. This does not match the ground truth's resolution, which was to eliminate the confusing term.
